passage:
Counsellor's note, written by Shalini.
Lalremsiami, Class 10, wants to take the arts stream and apply to a design course. Her family has planned science and medical coaching. She told me she fears being called selfish and letting everyone down, and she has not raised it at home. She spoke clearly about her reasons: a portfolio she has already started, a design college she has read about, and how she would support the family later.
I did not choose for her. I asked her to write her reasons on one page and offered to invite her parents to a meeting where they could share their own thoughts too. They came on Friday. Her father asked many questions and said he would visit the design college with her.

qa.q: Which stream does Lalremsiami want to take?
qa.a: Lalremsiami wants to take the arts stream.

qa.q: What is Lalremsiami afraid of, according to the note?
qa.a: She fears being called selfish and letting everyone down.

qa.q: What steps did Shalini take that respected both Lalremsiami and her family?
qa.a: Shalini asked Lalremsiami to write her reasons on one page and invited her parents to a meeting where they could share their thoughts as well.

qa.q: How did Lalremsiami's father respond at the meeting?
qa.a: Her father asked many questions and said he would visit the design college with her, which shows he was willing to listen and look.

grounding: A teenager wants a stream different from the family plan and fears being called selfish; explaining goals and inviting family thoughts respects both.

passage:
Sunday night. Papa's plan is commerce, so I can join the shop later. I want science and then biology. Every time I try to say it, the word "selfish" comes up in my head, as if wanting my own path means not caring about the family. Sangeeta, my older cousin, who took a different stream herself, says the wish itself isn't selfish. She told me to be clear, not loud.
So this is my plan. I will write down my reasons on one page: what I like about biology, what I could do with it, how I would still help at the shop on holidays. Then I will ask everyone to sit after dinner on Friday and tell me what they think. I want to hear them too.
Irawati

qa.q: Who told Irawati to be clear, not loud?
qa.a: Sangeeta, Irawati's older cousin, told Irawati to be clear, not loud.

qa.q: What is Irawati afraid of when trying to speak about the stream?
qa.a: Irawati is afraid of being called selfish, as if wanting a different path would mean not caring about the family.

qa.q: What is Irawati's plan for raising the subject at home?
qa.a: Irawati will write reasons on one page and ask everyone to sit after dinner on Friday, offering to help at the shop on holidays and listening to what they think.

qa.q: How might Sangeeta's own experience have helped Irawati?
qa.a: Sangeeta took a different stream herself, so she can show Irawati that wanting one's own path can be voiced without harming the family.

grounding: A teenager wants a stream different from the family plan and fears being called selfish, and plans to explain goals and hear the family.
